# StudyTracker

> StudyTracker is a modern, full-stack web application that helps students track their subjects, topics, progress, and exam dates. It includes a Pomodoro timer, countdown timers to exam dates, progress analytics, and drag-and-drop subject management.

## Features
- Subject & topic management with progress tracking
- Countdown timers to upcoming exam dates
- Pomodoro study timer
- Dashboard with progress analytics and charts
- Dark/light mode, Google OAuth authentication

## Technology
- Frontend: React (Vite), Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- Backend: Node.js, Express, MongoDB (Mongoose)

## Public pages
- Landing page: /
- Login: /login
- Register: /register

## Notes
The app requires authentication to access the main study-tracking features. All authenticated routes (/dashboard, /subjects, /settings) are private.
